name: Angelic Smile, Dorothy
jp_name: 天使の微笑 ドロシー
texts_en: Cont: This card gets +1000 power for each other <NIKKE> character in your back stage.

Auto: CxCombo When this card attacks, if "Wings of Paradise" is in your climax area, and you have 3 or more other <NIKKE> characters, look at up to 5 cards from the top of your deck, choose up to 1 <NIKKE> character from among them, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, put the rest into your waiting room, and this card gets +1000 power until end of turn.
script_expanded:
Cont: GiveSelf
{
	TargetLocation Backstage
	NarrowTargets HasTrait NIKKE && Other
	SetXValue TargetCount
	MultiplyXValue 1000
	GainPower X
}
Auto: OnAttack
{
	If Climax Wings of Paradise &&& StageContains 3 Other && HasTrait NIKKE
	{
		RevealUpTo Deck 5
		AIChoice AddToHand
		ChooseCardsFromTargets 0 1 HasTrait NIKKE && IsCharacter
		RevealTargets
		MoveCard Hand
		PutTheRestIntoTheWaitingRoom
		TargetSelf
		GainPower 1000
	}
}
